title: AI doctrines
description: Utility AI weights, response curves and faction doctrines (spec SAI-006..SAI-011, SAI-014..SAI-017, TAI-007..TAI-016). The faction → doctrine link is factions.doctrine (SAI-010); a doctrine does not list its factions.

personality.description: SAI-010 (strategic doctrines): faction character as consideration inputs (not set)

contractUse.description: SAI-014: how readily it posts contracts

commitmentBonus.description: SAI-008: bonus term for objectives the faction already pursues (input: SAI-006 vocabulary) (not set)

gainTerms.description: SAI-008: ownGain terms rated against the faction's ultimate goal: term name (SAI-006 gain-term vocabulary) → consideration (not set)

considerations.description: SAI-006 / TAI-007: flat map, name → consideration. Strategic names: SAI-006 vocabulary. Names are flat strings; a per-type consideration uses a dotted name, e.g. battleGoal.attack (TAI-009, spec choice), never a nested object

escortAccept.description: SAI-017 (Krug doctrine): Krug escort request scoring (not set)

considerations.description: name (price, standing, freeSquads, routeDanger; SAI-006 vocabulary) → consideration

threshold.description: Refusal threshold: accept only when the request's score is above it (SAI-017)

byWeaponType.description: DAT-011 weaponType → default role; a type with no entry gets no role

fitBonus.description: Added to the base action fit of an action matching the unit's role

claimTurns.description: Claims last until current turn + claimTurns (TAI-012)

consideration.description: One weighted consideration (SAI-006, TAI-007); shared by strategic and tactical doctrines

curve.description: Response curve, raw input → 0–1 (SAI-006, spec choice). linear: piecewise-linear through points; step: y of the last point whose x ≤ input. Both clamp outside the points (input below the first x → first y, above the last → last y)

points.description: [x, y] pairs sorted by x; x in the input's unit, y in 0–1
